contexts: hospital cardiac rehabilitation, city and rural catchment
patient choice of setting since January 2023
reading: Completion is shaped by who chooses each setting (younger, working, male patients choosing remote), by distance for the centre programme and by digital access for the remote one. The published difference in completion between settings shrinks or vanishes once definitions and choice are handled, so the local comparison stands or falls on a single definition and honest adjustment.
